  APPLICATION OF SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER
  COMPANY FOR AUTHORITY TO AMEND TARIFFS FOR
RETAIL ELECTRIC SERVICE TO INCLUDE NEW STANDARD
FORM CONTRACT FOR ELECTRIC SERVICE – LARGE LOAD




                        SOAH ORDER NO. 6
                 CONSOLIDATING MUNICIPAL APPEALS

      On February 19, 2026, and February 27, 2026, Southwestern Electric Power
Company (SWEPCO) filed its Petition and Second Petition for Review and
Motions to Consolidate (Motion). SWEPCO asserts that the cities of Alba, Avery,
Beckville, Big Sandy, Bloomburg, Carthage, Childress, Clarendon, DeKalb,
Dodson, Estelline, Fruitvale, Gary, East Mountain, Gilmer, Union Grove, Gary,
East Mountain, Gilmer, Union Grove, Warren City, Grand Saline, Hallsville,
Hedley, Hooks, Leary, Hughes Springs, Lakeview, Linden, Lakeport, Maud,
Memphis, Mount Vernon, Nash, New Boston, Omaha, Overton, Queen City,
Scottsville, Shamrock, Tatum, Tenaha, Red Lick, Texarkana, Wake Village,
 Wellington, Clarksville City, Miller's Cove, Winfield, Atlanta, Bloomburg, Center,
Clarksville City, Gladewater, Grand Saline, Hallsville, Hughes Springs, Kilgore,
Longview, Marshall, Memphis, Mount Pleasant, Mount Vernon, Overton,
Pittsburg, Queen City, Wake Village, Waskom, Winnsboro, and Winona
(collectively, Cities) in which it operates denied SWEPCO’s requested rate
change. SWEPCO appeals the Cities’ decisions and requests that the appeals be
consolidated with this rate case to promote regulatory efficiency, stating that the
appeals involve common questions of law and fact to those in this proceeding. No
objections were filed. SWEPCO’s Motion is GRANTED and the appeals of
Cities’ denials are CONSOLIDATED for review with this docket.


Signed April 21, 2026


                                         _____________________________
                                         Rachelle Nicolette Robles
                                         Administrative Law Judge
